title: Why your heart keeps RACING after you stop ❤️
caption:
Your body is still refilling oxygen and energy stores, moving heat out and clearing waste. The fitter you get, the faster your heart rate drops. 👇

Why Does This Happen? #8
first_comment: How fast does YOUR heart rate drop after a hard set? ❤️
